=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===
- .github/workflows/clarify.yml:line 462 (`printf '%s\n' "${err_text}" >&2` inside the inline `gh_retry_to_file` fallback) | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: When the captured `err_text` already ends in a newline (typical for `gh` CLI error output), `printf '%s\n'` emits a second newline, producing a blank line in the runner log between the echoed error and the next `::warning::` line.
  WHY: The blank line is cosmetic only — downstream greps are not anchored to fixed-width lines and the step still converges correctly. The runner log just gets an extra empty line per captured retry.
- .github/workflows/clarify.yml:the `if gh_retry_to_file ... && jq -s ... && python3 ...` chain in `Decide clarify route` | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: When the chain fails, the `else` branch logs the same generic `::warning::final_merge_resume check failed for closed issue #N` regardless of whether `gh_retry_to_file`, `jq`, or the Python script failed.
  WHY: The close-issue skip is the intended outcome in every case, so runtime behavior is correct. The cost is operator-side diagnostic ambiguity: a permanent 404, a network error, an empty body, a `jq` bug, and a Python crash all produce the same warning text. Splitting the message (or naming the failed command) would let operators tell degraded-mode API failures from script bugs without reading the full log.
(No task gaps reported.)
